paragraphs.text: The River Nish is an important flooding river on the subcontinent of Tamingazin , part of the continent of Otaria on Dominaria

The River Nish is filled with roiling green waters home to attalo . It acts as the border between the Valley of Tamingazin and the Great Marsh north of Suderbod . The Magewall crosses the river, meaning anyone sailing from Berimish to the sea will be subjected to the wall's magical slow-time. The river prominently features attalo , voracious giant tortoises that can kill a human with a single bite. For this reason, throwing prisoners in the river is an execution method in the city of Berimish.

After the assassination of King Tagard Tarngold , the brainwashed wizard Aligarius Timni and the Suderbod ambassador Ursal Daleel escaped by sailing down the River Nish and crossing the magewall while on the ship.
